=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:31332-31487 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new #8808 stale-close poller tests (from line 31336 onward) are defined after `if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())` (lines 31332-31333), so `main()` (line 28500) builds `tests_by_name` from `globals()` (line 28511) before those tests exist.
  WHY: The CI shards orchestrate-poll (2), (3) and (4) exit 1 with "FAIL <name>: unknown test name", so none of the poller fixture coverage runs; all reviewers rated this BLOCKER, and the fix is to move the block above the `__main__` guard.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19273 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The close-success `tg_notify_issue ... "INFO"` call in `_heal_stale_close_check` passes an unsupported alert level.
  WHY: In tg_helpers.sh, `_tg_level_num` maps unknown levels to 0 (DEBUG), which the default `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=WARNING` threshold suppresses, and `_tg_level_icon` renders them with the CRITICAL siren; tests/test_alert_levels_human_only.py::test_no_invalid_alert_level_strings (line 123) fails on this call. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19236-19241 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_heal_stale_close_check` treats a null or non-OPEN `linked_pr` as proof that no open fix PR exists. The cache it reads is built at 22355-22380 (and 22491) only from PRs with `willCloseTarget == true`, plus `| last`. That misses open `ai/issue-<n>` PRs that use `Refs` (implement.yml:6156), and it misses an older open closing PR when a newer closed or merged one exists.
  WHY: Once the green-run conditions hold, the poller posts the close marker and closes the held heal issue while its fix PR is still open, which breaks the "No open PR has head `ai/issue-<n>`" requirement. The decide-side check is at workflow_failure_heal.py:10169-10176. Reviewers rated it MAJOR with confidence 3 to 5.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:10193-10214 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `heal_stale_decision` silently skips malformed `workflow_runs` entries (`if not isinstance(run, dict): continue`, plus missing or invalid fields) instead of returning `runs_unavailable`. The poller-side filter is at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19222-19224. Luna also notes that successful entries are not checked for the run URL and SHA the close comment needs.
  WHY: A response with five valid green runs plus malformed entries can still close the issue, which breaks the fail-open requirement ("Any API error or malformed response keeps the issue open"). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined to adopt this finding as speculative.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19121 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `local phase="$5"` in `_heal_stale_close_check` is assigned but never read (shellcheck SC2034).
  WHY: It has no runtime effect, but it can keep the pre-push shellcheck tier red. Reviewers disagree on severity: gemini says MAJOR, the other four say NIT, and the highest is used here.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19264-19273 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_heal_stale_close_check` closes held heal issues with no human approval. `HEAL_STALE_AUTO_CLOSE_ENABLED` defaults to true and there is no per-issue opt-out label or dry-run mode.
  WHY: This unattended one-way write relies on a precondition gauntlet that has known gaps (the Refs-linked PR and malformed-runs findings above), so an issue can be closed while a fix PR is open.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19236-19267 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The check uses a cached issue/PR snapshot (19236-19247), then runs the run lookup and comment operations (19259-19267) and closes the issue, without rechecking the issue phase or the open-PR condition.
  WHY: A maintainer approval, or an implement workflow creating `ai/issue-<n>`, can happen after the snapshot, so the poller closes the issue based on stale state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19129-19131 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `HEAL_STALE_AUTO_CLOSE_ENABLED` is normalized with printf/tr/sed logic that differs from other security-sensitive gates.
  WHY: The reviewer says crafted env values risk a bypass. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 rejected this, citing the specified semantics and the identical pattern at line 18912.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2898-2903 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `HEAL_STALE_GREEN_RUNS` accepts values above 100, but the workflow-runs request at 19218-19219 is capped at 100 results.
  WHY: Above that threshold, the issue is silently kept as `too_few_green_runs` forever. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point as hardening suggestions.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:31332-31333, plus the #8808 block from line 31336 on | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new poller fixture tests come after `raise SystemExit(main())`; `main()` (line 28500) builds `tests_by_name` from globals at line 28511, so they are never registered.
  WHY: CI shards print "unknown test name" (orchestrate-poll (2), (3)) and exit 1, so no poller-level check runs; this is also the root cause behind GLM's "env override routing" theory.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:`_heal_stale_close_check` close-success `tg_notify_issue ... "INFO" || true` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `INFO` is unsupported; `_tg_level_num` (tg_helpers.sh lines 58-66) maps it to DEBUG, and `_tg_level_icon` (lines 70-78) maps it to the siren icon.
  WHY: The default WARNING threshold filters the close notice out; tests/test_alert_levels_human_only.py::test_no_invalid_alert_level_strings (line 123) fails.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:`_heal_stale_close_check` linked-PR block; `_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql` lines 22355-22380 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `linked_pr` holds only the last `willCloseTarget == true` PR, which misses `Refs`-linked open `ai/issue-<n>` PRs (implement.yml:6156) and an older open PR followed by a newer closed one (`| last`).
  WHY: The issue gets closed while an open fix PR exists; scan for any OPEN PR with `head_ref == "ai/issue-<n>"` or fail closed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:`_heal_stale_close_check` `local phase="$5"` | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The variable is assigned and never read (SC2034).
  WHY: No runtime effect; shellcheck noise, and it is unconfirmed whether this line triggers the gate failure.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Tests: ... poller fixture: a held heal issue with green runs is closed in one tick", plus the flag false, invalid flag/integer, duplicate marker and N-1 cases.
  Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, above the `if __name__ == "__main__":` guard.
  Evidence of absence: The tests exist only after `raise SystemExit(main())` (line 31333) and CI reports "unknown test name"; the pure-function cases in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py are present.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh HEAL_STALE_GREEN_RUNS defaults block near line 2896, and `per_page` clamp to 100 | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: A value above 100 can never be met, so the issue is kept forever as `too_few_green_runs`; suggested fix: warn and clamp to 90 (4 lines).

  - GLM's env-override and stream findings.
  - Gemini's flag-normalization finding.
  - Luna's malformed-run-entries finding (speculative).
  - Gemini's generation-2 TASK_GAP.
  - Pre-push failures not mapped to this diff (likely from merge commit 3e7338b).
  - copilot `custom_instructions_too_large` (HTTP 422), an infrastructure problem.
